title: Perspective Bar: contextual micro-navigation for multi-workspace sessions
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: switching context between workspaces, rollouts, cost views and dashboards requires multiple clicks and obscures temporal state (recent rollouts, active canaries, cost spikes). Goal: design a lightweight, persistent 'Perspective Bar' that sits above the console workspace and surfaces micro-previews, quick switches, and contextual actions (open dashboard, jump to rollout, pin cost lens) without full context loads. Must be keyboard accessible, permission-aware, and low-risk for existing IA.
acceptance_criteria: Perspective Bar present in top chrome of workspace in prototype and final implementation
Keyboard shortcut (Shift+P) opens the Perspective menu and is discoverable via Command+K hints
Micro-preview cards show: workspace name, active rollout state, 24h cost delta, last 1h median latency (or N/A), and a quick action button
Permission model hides rollout quick-actions for users without release privileges
Telemetry events emitted for open/switch/pin actions (events: perspective_open, perspective_switch, perspective_pin)
A/B experiment configured to measure time-to-context-switch and task success against baseline
design_decisions: Use a compact, single-row bar to avoid pushing console content; expand to stacked cards only on explicit open
Micro-preview cards constrained to 320px width with truncated metrics and tooltip details
Primary CTA is a one-click 'Jump' that preloads target workspace in the background to keep perceived latency <300ms
Fallback behavior: when target workspace unavailable, surface compatible model variant and 'Open in read-only' option
Accessibility: full keyboard nav + aria-live announcements when switching perspectives; color contrast to satisfy WCAG AA
Design tokens: reuse console color tokens and micro-typography scale to keep density consistent
research_notes: Guerrilla test (n=6 engineers): median time to find and switch workspace dropped from ~12s to ~5s using prototype
Participants liked cost delta visible on card; asked for 'show last 7 days' hover state
Confusion around iconography for rollouts — replaced generic 'rocket' with labeled pill (Canary | Stable)
Concerns about clutter when many workspaces pinned; decided to surface most-recent + pinned, with overflow menu
dev_notes: Backend: needs new lightweight summary endpoint /v1/workspaces/:id/perspective-summary returning {name, rollout_status, cost_delta_24h, latency_1h}
Frontend: component live in console top chrome; should lazy-load metric values and fallback to cached snapshot
Telemetry: add events perspective_open, perspective_close, perspective_switch, perspective_pin, perspective_view_metric
Performance budget: initial bar render must not increase CLS or initial paint by >10ms on average session
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Rivera): prioritize permission model and ensure cost numbers map to existing cost API
Engineering (Diego Alvarez): prefer prefetch throttling to avoid GPU/serving spikes; require circuit-breaker for summary endpoint
Security (Nina Okoye): confirm that rollout metadata doesn't expose internal feature flags; treat as sensitive until PRD clarification
Design critique (Lina Gomez): tighten vertical rhythm and increase tappable area of micro-action buttons to 44px
next_steps: Lock final token/metric mapping with backend owners (due 2025-02-21)
Build high-fidelity Figma for handoff and record interaction spec (due 2025-02-28)
Implement prototype react component behind feature flag and add telemetry (ENG-34200)
Run 2-week A/B experiment for power users and measure task completion and time-to-switch
Prepare rollout plan that can be gated by workspace role/plan
